title: Driver's medical exam
what: Several doctors check that you have no conditions that stop you driving safely. Then you get a medical certificate for your license.
why: Before getting a license, when renewing it, after a suspension, or for work as a driver.
duration: usually 1 to 3 hours, if all doctors are in one place; the certificate is often given the same day
tell_doctor: If you wear glasses or contacts

prepare.title: Checklist
prepare.text: Ask the clinic which doctors you need: usually a GP, an eye doctor, a psychiatrist, and an addiction specialist, and more for some license categories.

prepare.title: Certificates
prepare.text: Sometimes the psychiatric and addiction certificates come from separate clinics. Check in advance.

prepare.title: The day before
prepare.text: Get a good night's sleep, and do not drink alcohol.

bring: Glasses or contacts, if you wear them
A photo, if the clinic asks
steps: At the front desk, a form is filled in, and you get a list of rooms
The eye doctor checks your vision, color vision, and visual field
The GP checks your blood pressure and asks about your health
The psychiatrist and addiction specialist ask questions
feel: There may be queues. Allow extra time
after: Hand in the certificate when applying for your license
The certificate is valid for a limited time. Check how long
If a doctor has doubts, you may be sent for tests

faq.q: Can I pass the exam with glasses?
faq.a: Yes. If your vision is good enough with glasses, the certificate will say you may drive only with them.

faq.q: How long is the certificate valid?
faq.a: It depends on the country's rules. Check with the clinic or when you hand in your documents.

reminders.text: Driver's medical tomorrow. Bring your ID, and your glasses or contacts if you wear them.
